description: The story floor: a bullpen of mismatched desks shoved into a horseshoe around a whiteboard nobody has erased in months, three drafts deep in different hands. Index cards march across a corkboard wall in acts, half of them pinned crooked, one just reading FIX THE ENDING. A wall of muted monitors carries the feed the room is writing for, and the carpet is worn to grey tramlines between the coffee urn and the door. A sign over the board reads FUNNY BY FOUR OR IT AIRS SAD.
name: KSAB Story Floor
